visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing a black blazer and white lacy top, walks toward the camera in a forest-like park. She talks directly to the viewer. Behind her, a man in a blue jacket and another woman follow. A massive wooden Torii gate stands in the distant background under bright, natural daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a long, wide path surrounded by dense, towering green trees whose branches arch over the road. Numerous pedestrians are walking along this broad paved way. (3) The group walks past a large wall of stacked sake barrels decorated with traditional Japanese patterns and a wall of white lanterns with 'New Year' calligraphy. The lighting remains bright and natural. (4) A medium full shot shows the exterior of a traditional wooden shrine building. Several people stand with their backs to the camera, tossing coins into an offertory box. (5) The group is then seen at a wide grass field during sunset. The sun is low on the horizon, casting a warm golden light. The two women lie on the dry grass, looking up at the sky and waving their hands. (6) A final shot shows a peaceful pond reflecting the sunset colors in the clouds above the silhouette of trees.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a group of friends visiting Meiji Jingu in Tokyo during the New Year period. It captures the atmosphere of the shrine, the traditional decorations like sake barrels and lanterns, and the peaceful natural environment of the surrounding park, culminating in a relaxed moment at sunset.
